description: Format, minify, check or read a value out of JSON, pointing at any error

file.description: Read a file's exact bytes instead <path>

get.description: Print what is at a dotted path, such as data.listeners.0.pid <path>

value.description: The text to convert; - or nothing reads what is piped in

name: convert.json

found.description: Whether that path was there; null when none was asked for.

line.description: Where the first error is, from 1; null when it is valid.

output.description: The formatted or minified JSON, or what --get asked for; null with --check, when the JSON is invalid, and when the path was not there.

path.description: The path --get asked for; null when none was.

value.description: What was at the path, as JSON rather than as text; null when there was nothing to take.

output.description: What a program the command ran printed

truncated.description: Where the result was cut to fit, and how much
